def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[2 if grid[r][c] == 2 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    blocks = [(r,c) for r in range(h-1) for c in range(w-1)
              if all(grid[rr][cc]==2 for rr in (r,r+1) for cc in (c,c+1))]
    for r,c in blocks:
        spots=[(r-1,c-1),(r-1,c+2),(r+2,c-1),(r+2,c+2)]
        vals=[grid[rr][cc] for rr,cc in spots]
        colors=[vals[2],vals[0],vals[3],vals[1]]
        for (rr,cc),color,(dr,dc) in zip(spots,colors,[(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]):
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                if grid[rr][cc]==2: break
                out[rr][cc]=color
                nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                if not (0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w): break
                if grid[nr][nc]==2 or grid[nr][cc]==2 or grid[rr][nc]==2: break
                rr,cc=nr,nc
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[2 if grid[r][c] == 2 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    blocks = [(r,c) for r in range(h-1) for c in range(w-1)
              if all(grid[rr][cc] == 2 for rr in (r,r+1) for cc in (c,c+1))]
    records=[]
    for bi,(r,c) in enumerate(blocks):
        spots=[(r-1,c-1),(r-1,c+2),(r+2,c-1),(r+2,c+2)]
        vals=[grid[rr][cc] for rr,cc in spots]
        colors=[vals[2],vals[0],vals[3],vals[1]]
        records.append((spots,colors))
    for bi,((spots,colors),(r,c)) in enumerate(zip(records,blocks)):
        for (sr,sc),color,(dr,dc) in zip(spots,colors,[(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]):
            rr,cc=sr,sc
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                if grid[rr][cc]==2: break
                out[rr][cc]=color
                near_matching_marker=False
                for bj,(other_spots,other_colors) in enumerate(records):
                    if bj==bi: continue
                    if any(col==color and max(abs(rr-mr),abs(cc-mc))<=1 for (mr,mc),col in zip(other_spots,other_colors)):
                        near_matching_marker=True; break
                if near_matching_marker: break
                rr += dr; cc += dc
    return out
